description: Public Service Commission - Notify the Amendment of the  Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Principals'Service, Published in Gaz.Ex.No. 1885/31 of 22.10.2014
categorisation: This gazette content pertains specifically to amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Principals' Service, detailing interim provisions for promotions, qualification requirements, and efficiency bar examinations. This falls under public sector service administration, specifically addressing service conditions, promotion criteria, and qualification requirements for principals, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes).
